title: Chicken Quesadillas
description: Chicken Quesadillas are filled with juicy seasoned chicken, sautéed peppers, onions, and melted cheese inside crispy golden flour tortillas. Served with salsa, guacamole, and sour cream, they make a classic Mexican favorite that's perfect for lunch, dinner, or sharing.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken
items: Chicken breasts (~500 g), boneless, skinless – 2 large

ingredients.title: For the Quesadillas
items: Shredded cheese (Mexican blend, Chihuahua, or Oaxaca) – 1½ cups
Red bell pepper, thinly sliced – ½
Yellow bell pepper, thinly sliced – ½

ingredients.title: Optional Toppings & Sides
items: Pico de gallo or fresh salsa

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Chicken
steps: Slice chicken breasts into thin strips for even cooking.
In a medium bowl, toss chicken with olive oil, smoked paprika, cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, salt, pepper, and lime juice. Let marinate for 15–30 minutes (optional for deeper flavor).
Heat a skillet or grill pan over medium-high heat. Sear chicken strips 3–4 minutes per side until cooked through and slightly charred. Remove and set aside.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Sauté the Vegetables
steps: In the same skillet, lightly sauté the bell peppers and onion for 2–3 minutes until slightly tender but still crisp. Set aside.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Assemble the Quesadillas
steps: Lay a tortilla flat and sprinkle a generous layer of shredded cheese on half of it.
Add cooked chicken strips and sautéed vegetables on top of the cheese.
Sprinkle a little more cheese over the filling (helps it stick).
Fold the tortilla in half to cover the filling.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Cook the Quesadillas
steps: Heat a clean skillet over medium heat (lightly oil or butter if desired).
Cook the folded quesadilla 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown and the cheese melts. Press gently with a spatula for a crisp crust.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Serve
steps: Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with sour cream, guacamole, salsa, and lime wedges on the side.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot with sour cream, guacamole, pico de gallo, or fresh salsa.
Pair with Mexican rice, refried beans, or a fresh salad.
Enjoy with lime wedges for an extra burst of freshness.

chefTips: Use a mix of cheeses: a mild melting cheese (like Oaxaca or mozzarella) and a sharper cheese for depth of flavor.
Don't overload the quesadilla—too much filling prevents proper browning.
Finish with a squeeze of lime and a sprinkle of fresh cilantro for a fresh, vibrant finish.
For an extra touch, lightly butter the skillet or brush the tortilla with oil before cooking for a perfectly golden, crispy exterior.
